report_title: Phase 5 Comprehensive False Positive & Hard Negative Acoustic Audit

meditation_chimes_special_case.finding: The singular file meditation_hypnosis--110246.mp3 (17.87s of Tibetan singing bowl / metallic chime strikes) accounts for over 40% of all false positive windows at threshold 0.690. YAMNet classifies these metallic transient strikes with 57.3% confidence as Explosion and 56.0% as Gunshot, representing a fundamental frozen-backbone acoustic embedding limitation. In Phase 5, this file is preserved untouched in the test set.
